components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string

content.text:
All green. Here's how I addressed each finding.

## Changes made

I agreed with all four findings — they correctly point at the codebase's established idioms (the `x-field-extra-annotation` → `ConstraintValidator` mechanism already used by `PetAgeValidation`, and MapStruct for DTO→entity transformation). The rule is now split into its two natural units:

**Validation → Bean Validation constraint** (findings 1, 2, 4)
- Added `rest/validation/TelephoneValidation.java` (constraint annotation) and `TelephoneValidator.java` (`ConstraintValidator<TelephoneValidation, String>`), mirroring `PetAgeValidation`/`PetAgeValidator`. The validator strips non-digits and checks for exactly 10, returning `true` for `null` so `@NotNull`/`@NotEmpty` own that case — same convention as `PetAgeValidator`.
- Wired it onto the generated `OwnerFieldsDto.telephone` field in `openapi.yml` via `x-field-extra-annotation`, exactly as `birthDate` does. Invalid input now flows through `MethodArgumentNotValidException` → `ExceptionControllerAdvice`, producing the same structured 400 body as every other field rejection, instead of a bare bodyless 400.

**Normalization → MapStruct** (finding 3)
- Added a `@Named("normalizeTelephone")` default method in `OwnerMapper` and referenced it with `@Mapping(target = "telephone", qualifiedByName = "normalizeTelephone")` on `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)`. The digit-stripping now happens where DTO→entity field transformation belongs; the awkward map-then-overwrite is gone.

**Controller** — reverted `addOwner` to its original thin form (no helper, no manual `BAD_REQUEST`), matching every other method in the class.

## Note on scope
I kept the transformation scoped to the create path (`toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)`) rather than the shared `toOwner(OwnerDto)`, since the spec is create-only. But because the rule now lives as a reusable constraint + mapper method rather than a private controller helper, it's reachable by `updateOwner`, the v2 controller, or tests should that be wanted later (finding 4).

## Tests
Full `./mvnw test`: BUILD SUCCESS. `coreStripsToTenDigits` (`(04) 1234-5678` → `0412345678`) and `errorRejectsTooFewDigits` (`12345` → 400) both pass — acceptance behaviour unchanged.
